commentaries.author: Parimelazhagar
commentaries.text:
Her friend teases her: he means to leave, so why don’t you sulk? She answers.

Elation at a mere thought and joy at a mere sight don’t come to those who drink toddy. They come to those who have desire. The first leaves the senses whole, and the second doesn’t. Toddy gives both only when it is drunk. With desire like this, how could I sulk?
